name: Aerial Loom
promptTemplate: A monumental woven net sculpture floating over a night plaza in {{palette}} illumination, billowing with {{wind_energy}} wind force, {{mesh_density}} mesh weave, {{glow_intensity}} uplight glow, audio reactivity at {{audio_reactivity}}, and skyline silhouette {{skyline_depth}}.

palette.hint: Swaps the floodlight gradient beneath the mesh

wind_energy.hint: Ripples billows and sweeps the catenary curves

mesh_density.hint: Changes filament count and diagonal lattice

glow_intensity.hint: Adjusts beam brightness and node gleam

audio_reactivity.hint: Drives upward bass pulse through the net

skyline_depth.hint: Toggles backdrop towers and rooftop beacons

listing.blurb: A monumental woven net floats over a night plaza, billowing in the breeze and catching vibrant uplighting while the room shifts its wind, weave, and colours.
listing.prompt: A monumental net sculpture floating over a city plaza at night: a vast soft mesh hanging from buildings, billowing in the wind like a jellyfish, lit from below in slowly shifting colours, the fibres drawn as thousands of fine translucent lines. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
